text.description_html:
Omnia AP-720/220-US32D, 15 Inch Air-Stream Stainless Steel Refrigerator Handle

The future is here with the 15 inch Air-Stream Stainless Steel Appliance Pull. This refrigerator handle has a unique oblong shape that gives off the air of sci-fi spaceships. This will lend an ultra modern look to any appliance. It is made out of stainless steel with a satin stainless steel finish. The Air-Stream Stainless Steel Refrigerator Handle is easy to install and comes with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Also Available Air-Stream Stainless Steel Door Pull

Specifications for the Omnia 720/220-US32D Air-Stream Appliance Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Overall Length: 15"
  • Center to Center Mount: 8-5/8" (c.c.)
  • Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Mounting Bracket Diameter: 13/16"
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thick Appliance Panel

Sold Individually
